methods.noHealth: Future integration: PMC/State health surveillance data.

authority.deliveryUnknown: Delivery status is unknown. Check before retrying.

subscribe.start: Open Telegram and press Start to confirm.
subscribe.stop: Send /stop to the Telegram bot to delete your subscriptions.
subscribe.deleted: Your subscription and delivery details have been deleted.
worker.hours: Lower-exposure hours for the selected day

validation.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked in this browser. Change the permission in browser settings to subscribe.

validation.tooMany: Too many requests. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
status.noRun: No pipeline run has been recorded.
authority.server.role: Current role: {role}. Membership is checked again on each operation.
authority.server.created: Draft stored. Review the exact revision before approval.
authority.server.approveResult: Approval recorded. Delivery remains a separate action.
authority.server.sendResult: Test-delivery request processed. Inspect the delivery results.
authority.server.cancelResult: Cancellation recorded. Audit evidence is retained.
